name: io.github.Mr-Didi/mcp-ocei-oracle
title: OCEI v2.3 Orbital Compute & Arbitrage Oracle
description: ES256-attested orbital AI physics, NOAA weather, D1 TWAP & $/MTok ERCOT/PJM/EPEX arbitrage oracle.

tools.name: evaluate_orbital_compute_regime
tools.description: Full physics, 5-year TCO, and credit-underwriting audit for an orbital AI cluster. Use this tool for deep thermodynamic, radiation, Turyshev communication-intensity (bits/J), attrition stress (3.5%/9.0%), $/W payback, and 4-pillar OCEI v2.3 scoring. Do NOT use for fast binary electricity dispatch (use compute_arbitrage_dispatch) or multi-shell percentage routing (use solve_optimal_workload_allocation).

power_mw.description: Target cluster electrical capacity in megawatts (1 to 100,000 MW).

beta_deg.description: Solar beta angle in degrees (75-90 yields zero eclipse at 650 km).

launch_vehicle.description: Heavy-lift launch vehicle mass and price model.

loop_temp_c.description: Radiator coolant loop temperature in Celsius (80C optimal for commercial silicon; 95C for Terafab 370K).

grid_price_usd_mwh.description: Custom terrestrial grid tariff in USD/MWh (overrides grid_hub if provided).

grid_hub.description: Select live D1 wholesale electricity hub (ercot=Texas, pjm=Virginia, epex=Europe) or canonical $115/MWh baseline.

earth_capex_factor.description: Terrestrial civil/substation CapEx multiplier (1.0=Tier-IV utility, 0.6=vertically integrated self-build).

annual_attrition_pct.description: Annual unrepairable hardware attrition rate in percent (0=raw baseline, 3.5=burn-in screened, 9.0=unscreened stress).

comm_intensity_bits_per_flop.description: Workload I/O intensity in bits/FLOP (1e-8=text/reasoning, 2e-6=rich multimodal) for Turyshev Gamma downlink checks.

storm_mode.description: Space weather telemetry source: live NOAA/GOES streams or deterministic G0/G3/G5 stress profile.

tools.name: compute_arbitrage_dispatch
tools.description: Fast binary go/no-go economic dispatch decision comparing a single terrestrial electricity price or live hub (ERCOT, PJM, EPEX) against the orbital breakeven threshold ($/MWh). Returns exact dispatch_signal (ORBIT_PRIMARY, HYBRID_SPLIT, TERRESTRIAL_PRIMARY), dispatch_directive, breakeven threshold, and $/MTok spread. Use ONLY for binary grid-vs-orbit switching; use solve_optimal_workload_allocation for 3-shell percentage splits.

power_mw.description: Cluster scale in MW used to size launch/bus overhead and breakeven threshold.

grid_price_usd_mwh.description: Explicit local spot electricity price in USD/MWh (supports negative wind/solar spot prices). If omitted, uses grid_hub.

grid_hub.description: Live wholesale electricity hub to evaluate when grid_price_usd_mwh is omitted.

hw.description: Hardware stack profile determining $/MTok and breakeven $/MWh.

storm_mode.description: Space-weather mode for pre-emptive storm failover triggers.

tools.name: solve_optimal_workload_allocation
tools.description: Multi-shell percentage constraint solver for cluster schedulers (SkyPilot, Kubernetes, SOOS). Outputs exact percentage splits across 650 km Dawn-Dusk SSO, 320 km self-cleaning VLEO Edge, and Terrestrial Spot Grids based on workload latency SLA, Turyshev downlink intensity (bits/FLOP), space weather, and electricity price. Returns optimal_split_pct and blended $/1M token cost.

workload_type.description: AI workload class controlling latency sensitivity and batchability.

max_latency_ms.description: Maximum acceptable one-way network latency in ms (<=6 ms prioritizes 320 km VLEO).

grid_price_usd_mwh.description: Spot grid price in USD/MWh; if omitted, uses grid_hub.

grid_hub.description: Live wholesale electricity hub (ercot, pjm, epex) or $115/MWh baseline.

comm_intensity_bits_per_flop.description: Turyshev I/O intensity (bits/FLOP); automatically shifts downlink-bound multimodal workloads to Earth.

tools.name: get_ocei_history_and_live_grids
tools.description: Retrieves empirical Cloudflare D1 time-series snapshots of OCEI-Spot, true 60-minute settlement TWAP, rolling 30-day covenant availability, and all 3 live wholesale spot electricity hubs (ERCOT Texas, PJM Virginia, EPEX Europe). Use this tool for historical trend comparison, SLA/insurance covenant auditing, or live electricity price lookup.

hours.description: Lookback window in hours (1 to 720 hours / 30 days).

limit.description: Maximum number of D1 snapshot rows to return.
